missions.name: TRAINING  /  INITIATION
missions.description: A controlled assessment at the fictional Civic Evaluation Annex.
missions.briefing: Ruby: Your primary target is the moving assessment unit in the chamber. Disable it, complete the three record lessons, and leave through the marked exit. Each lesson earns one permanent coin. The two guards are part of the evaluation.
missions.debrief: Ruby: You kept your head. Blackline can use that. The next file is already on your desk.

missions.name: OPERATION 01  /  TUNG CHUNG
missions.description: The USB robber, Constance’s operative, the first physical key, and a separate train pursuit.
missions.briefing: Ruby: The USB robber and Constance’s operative are both active in Tung Chung. Permanently complete both through the assessment tag, physically recover Key 01, then pursue the separate train courier and extract.
missions.debrief: Ruby: The robber never opened the sealed USB. Constance’s operative confirms a handoff toward the streets; the file’s contents and client remain unknown.

missions.name: OPERATION 02  /  THE STREETS
missions.description: A market operation targeting Constance’s local vendor and a separate physical key.
missions.briefing: Ruby: The market vendor is a mandatory target. Permanently complete the target with an assessment tag, physically recover Key 02 from the guarded office, and extract.
missions.debrief: Ruby: The market evidence points to a corporate fixer. Key 02 is physically verified.

missions.name: OPERATION 03  /  COMMERCIAL DISTRICT
missions.description: A corporate operation targeting the fixer and a separately secured records key.
missions.briefing: Ruby: Find the corporate fixer, permanently complete the target with an assessment tag, recover Key 03 from the records safe, then extract.
missions.debrief: Ruby: The fixer’s routing records lead to the wealthy businessman at the harbour. Key 03 is secure.

missions.name: OPERATION 04  /  HARBOUR & SKYLINE
missions.description: A waterfront operation targeting the wealthy businessman and Key 04.
missions.briefing: Ruby: The wealthy harbour businessman is a mandatory target. Permanently complete the target, physically recover Key 04 from the escort, and extract.
missions.debrief: Ruby: The businessman’s archive points to the Ngong Ping field operation. Key 04 is secure.

missions.name: OPERATION 05  /  NGONG PING
missions.description: The field operation reveals a vast, interconnected installation beneath and inside the Tian Tan Big Buddha.
missions.briefing: Ruby: The field archive was a screen. A huge installation lies beneath the Big Buddha and continues into concealed chambers within the statue. Find the hidden rear access, recover Key 05 from the separate field archive, locate Sora Cheng in the operations chamber, and reach the control-room extraction. The public monument must remain intact.
missions.debrief: Ruby: The installation is hidden beneath the statue and continues inside it. Key 05 is physically secured; the separate code needed for decryption is still missing.

missions.name: OPERATION 06  /  THE HOUSE
missions.description: A short recovery mission: enter the small safe house, open the guarded safe, record the separate 70-digit code, and leave.
missions.briefing: Ruby: All five physical keys are verified, but their file still needs a separate 70-digit code. Enter the safe house, reach the wall safe, recover the code, and extract. Keep this short and quiet; the local guards are not additional targets.
missions.debrief: Ruby: The safe supplied the independent 70-digit code. Five keys and the code open the USB decryption session; the file itself remains unrevealed.

missions.name: OPTIONAL  /  THE MERIDIAN
missions.description: Trace a missing archive through a luxury hotel.
missions.briefing: Ruby: Your primary target is Adrian Locke, the Meridian's operations director. Confront him or tag him for Blackline about the archive transfer. Ivo Chen is a records witness: question him and recover two records. The Covenant is interested too; we don't know why yet.
missions.debrief: Ruby: Locke's account, Chen's testimony and the records point beyond the hotel. The Covenant is not our employer, and I intend to learn who is paying them.

equipment.name: Training sidearm
equipment.description: Unsuppressed fictional assessment pulse. Five charges. Aim with right mouse; fire with left mouse.

equipment.name: Quiet line
equipment.description: Temporarily disables one nearby person without graphic effects. Q uses it.
